fato_historico: 1837: Tiffany & Co. (first named Tiffany & Young) is founded by Charles Lewis Tiffany and Teddy Young in New York City. The store is called a "stationery and fancy goods emporium".
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to curate beauty in your surroundings today. Much like the birth of a grand vision in a bustling city, you may find inspiration in small, exquisite details. It is a good time to polish your inner gems and consider how you share your unique luster with the world around you.
frase_do_dia: Your inner light is the most precious treasure you will ever possess.
significado_numero: Represents the manifestation of creative dreams and new beginnings.
conselho: Focus on the beauty of the present moment and polish your intentions.
